title: Air Force custodial PWS Attachment 2 / Appendix B workbook (XLSX): Notes, Summary and three zone tabs plus a GSU tab, Level 1/2/4 blocks with repeated stacked headers, Restroom / Carpet / Hard Floor / Other SF split, Amendment 0001 applied (row deleted, row added, SF re-measured, frequency changed), reference-only SCIF and optional-CLIN rows below the zone totals

sources.note: Dyess AFB Custodial Services PWS (13 Aug 2021), Appendix B "Estimated Square Footage and Cleaning Level". Fetched and read with pdftotext. Columns Facility No. / Description / User/Agency / Restroom SF / Carpet SF / Hard Floor SF / Total Cleaned SF per Facility; one block per cleaning level (Level 1 - Prestige, Level 2 - Basic, Level 4 - Special Requirement) with the header repeated; "Level N Total" rows that put the facility count in the Facility No. column ("81 Total # Facilities"); the same facility number on several lines (7008, 9203); letter-suffixed numbers (6030A/B/C, 7316A/B); partial areas ("3-Bay Hangar (Bay 1 Only)"); para 4.20.3 modification unit pricing from the Appendix B category totals (paraphrased in Notes tab Note 9). Format only; no rows copied.

Sheppard AFB / Frederick Auxiliary Airfield Custodial Services PWS (revised 3 Aug 2018), Appendix B "Estimated Square Footage and Cleaning Category". Fetched and read. Floor-finish split columns (Carpet / Vinyl / Ceramic / Concrete / Hardwood / Other / Total Sq Ft) with blank cells for zero; SUBTotal / TOTAL rows with the count in the Bldg # column; the same building in two categories (402, 920); two buildings at a separate auxiliary airfield (model for the GSU tab); Appendix A frequency wording "1x a week", "1x every two weeks", "3x a week". Format only.

Wright-Patterson AFB Custodial PWS for the CDCs and NASIC (2 Apr 2018), Appendix B (July 2018). Fetched and read. Spreadsheet-export look: two-decimal square footage (510.82, 4,545.19), "N/A" cells, stacked headers ("Total Cleaned SF per Facility (Carpet & Hard Floor)"), Level 2 and Level 4 blocks, a note on a contractor-occupied building, and "Per Occurrence / Total Per Month / Total Per Year" workload rows under the facility rows (model for the Summary workload block and the GSU decimals). Format only.

Aviano AB DRAFT Appendix B, Custodial Services (1 June 2021). Fetched and read. BUILDING NUMBER / AREA (zone code A1, C, D, E, F) / Floor / BUILDING DESCRIPTION / CARPET / NON-CARPET / RESTROOMS / TOTAL, Level 1 and Level 2 blocks with TOTALS rows, the same building on two lines (176), partial-building lines ("Hangar 3 - MAIN GF"), and a seasonal remark ("APR - OCT"). Model for the Zone column and the seasonal facility. Format only (the fixture uses SF, not m2).

Appendix A - Air Force Custodial Standards (stand-alone attachment). Fetched and read. Level 1 Prestige / Level 2 Basic / Level 3 Academics / Level 4 Special Requirements (Fitness Centers, CDC, Youth Center, SAP) and frequency wording ("1 x Week", "1 x every 2 Weeks", "2 x Week", "1 x Daily"). Model for Notes tab Note 3 and the Level 4 grouping.

Performance Work Statement for Custodial Services at Eielson AFB (168th Wing, Alaska ANG), State of Alaska public notice attachment. Known only from a web-search summary (host unreachable from this environment): a per-facility table of facility number, activity, square footage and service frequency (e.g. 2x a week). Only support for a per-building days-per-week column (Svc Freq). No content copied.

Joint Base Charleston Custodial Services, FA441826R0011 (2026): the package lists "Attachment 2 - Appendix B 14 April 2026 (XLS)" and re-issues it with the Rev 1 PWS by amendment. Known only from web-search summaries (the page and SAM.gov were not reachable from this environment); used only for the idea that Appendix B is issued as an Excel workbook named Attachment 2 and conformed by amendment. No content copied.

provenance.notes: Every value is illustrative: the base (Tallgrass Air Force Base, Kansas, and its Cottonwood Annex GSU are fictional), the host wing number (726 ABW) and unit symbols, the solicitation number FA4693-27-R-0007, Amendment 0001 and its date, all facility numbers, names and square footages. The workbook layout and wording follow the real Air Force custodial Appendix B tables cited (Dyess 2021, Sheppard 2018, Wright-Patterson 2018, Aviano 2021) and the Air Force Custodial Standards appendix. Those real appendices are PDFs; the XLSX form (Notes, Summary and one tab per zone) is the fixture's assumption, supported only by search summaries showing Appendix B issued as an XLS attachment (JB Charleston 2026). No rows were copied, so fidelity is real-format. gen.mjs builds the workbook source and this file from one table.

traps: Multi-sheet workbook: "Notes & Instructions", "Summary", three zone tabs and a GSU tab. Facility rows are only on the zone and GSU tabs.

The Summary tab repeats the totals twice (by zone and by cleaning level) and adds a workload block ("Per Occurrence" SF and "Total Per Year" = SF x annual service days, 103,276,102). None of these rows is a facility.

Every data tab has a three-row title block and a zone banner. Each cleaning-level block repeats a two-row stacked header with a merged "ESTIMATED SQUARE FOOTAGE (SF)" group cell, merged single-column headers and line breaks inside header cells.
Level subtotal and zone total rows put the facility COUNT in the Facility No. column ("13 | Level 2 Total - # Facilities"), as in the Dyess AFB Appendix B.
Same facility number on two lines: Bldg 2000 Command Section (Level 1, 6,215 SF) and Staff Agencies (Level 2, 18,540 SF). Truth keeps both line items in document order.
Letter-suffixed facility numbers 1158A / 1158B are separate facilities. They are text cells among numeric facility numbers.

Square footage is cleaning area, not gross area. Several rows are partial areas ("Admin & Shop Areas Only", "Break Room & Latrine Only", "Restrooms & Snack Bar Seating Only", dining room only). Truth sets grossSqft = cleanableSqft = Total Cleaned SF and leaves category off the partial-area rows, except the Dining Facility (3028), whose cleaned dining room, entry and restrooms are still dining space (category dining).
Total Cleaned SF is the sum of four split columns (Restroom + Carpet + Hard Floor + Other). Taking one split, or adding Restroom SF to the total again, gives the wrong area.

Distractor numbers sit beside the SF: No. of RR (restroom rooms, not fixtures), No. Flrs, User/Agency unit numbers (726 OSS, 727 ARS), zone ids, CLIN numbers, PWS paragraph numbers and annual service days.
Zero SF cells use four styles: blank, 0, "-" and "N/A".

Amendment 0001 is already applied in the cells. The Notes tab change log still prints the superseded Was values: 1180 at 4,868 SF, 2024 at 2,580 / 6,950, 3048 at 5 x Week, and the old grand total of 385,006.42.
A deleted row stays in place: 1180 sits inside the Zone 1 Level 2 block with level "N/A", Svc Freq "DELETED", zero SF and Rev "A1".

Rows below a zone total are out of scope: 2090 SCIF ("reference only - not on contract", 22,430 SF) and 3052 Optional CLIN 0006 Fitness Center Annex (9,850 SF). Both carry SF in the cells and the full repeated header.

Frequency wording: "5 x Week", "7 x Week", "6 x Week (Mon-Sat)", "3 x Week", "2 x Week", "1 x Week" and "1x every two weeks". 3032 is seasonal ("3 x Week (APR-OCT only)"), so it has no single service level and truth leaves serviceLevel off.
Cleaning Level (1 Prestige / 2 Basic / 4 Special Req) is a task standard, not the visit frequency. The visit frequency is the Svc Freq column (a Level 2 building can be 7 x Week).
Floors are printed as "1 + Mezz" on 1130, so truth leaves floors off. The 6-level control tower has only 1,096 cleaned SF.

The GSU tab is a separate site with 3-digit facility numbers and #,##0.00 format with measured decimals (2,207.75 and 435.67 SF). The grand total 385,092.42 therefore displays as 385,092 on the #,##0 Summary.
